review_candidates.title: Government and Public Sector - Digital Engineering - Drupal SME - Manager
review_candidates.description: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Government and Public Sector – Digital Engineering – Drupal Manager From strategy to execution, the Government & Public Sector practice of Ernst & Young provides a full range of consulting and audit services to help our Federal, State, Local and Education clients implement new ideas to help achieve their mission outcomes. We deliver real change and measurable results through our diverse, high-performing teams, quality work at the highest professional standards, operational know-how from across our global organization, and creative and bold ideas that drive innovation. We enable our government clients to achieve their mission of protecting the nation and serving the people; increasing public safety; improving healthcare for our military, veterans and citizens; delivering essential public services; and helping those in need. The opportunity Our Government & Public Sector (GPS) Digital Engineering practice is helping organizations solve complex problems through purpose-led transformation. To achieve this mission, a diverse and talented team from around the globe are creating innovative digital experiences that help our clients succeed and thrive. Our practice combines an understanding of the public sector's diverse mission needs with private sector leading practices. We respond to each client's issues by bringing together highly skilled professionals across our Consulting, Assurance, Tax and Strategy and Transactions service lines. This integrated approach provides the support and flexibility to meet the unique requirements of our clients. The Drupal SME - Manager will serve as the lead technical expert supporting client Web Content Management as a Service (WCMaaS) platforms. Your Key Responsibilities As a Drupal SME – Manager, you will Drupal architecture, development, modernization, migrations, operations and maintenance Tier III support for multiple enterprise and public-facing websites Work in an Agile environment supporting cloud-hosted Drupal solutions while ensuring security, accessibility, and compliance requirements are met Provide expert-level support for Drupal environments Design, develop, enhance, test, and deploy Drupal applications and shared platform services Perform Drupal upgrades, migrations, security patching, and code-base maintenance Support CI/CD pipelines, release management, and cloud-based hosting environments Collaborate with product owners, developers, and stakeholders in an Agile delivery model Mentor junior developers and establish Drupal development best practices In addition to your client’s responsibilities, you will also be expected to fulfil Manager-level responsibilities within the firm such as: Establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships Create innovative insights for clients, adapt methods and practices to fit operational team and cultural needs, and contribute to thought leadership Anticipate and identify risks, and escalate any issues as appropriate Develop people through effectively supervising, coaching and mentoring staff; help create a positive learning culture Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff Skills And Attributes For Success Strong leadership skills and excellent oral and written communication skills Experience coming up with solutions to problems Prior consulting experience To qualify for the role, you must have Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field 8+ years of related experience with drupal development and administration Experience supporting enterprise-scale or federal Drupal implementations Eligibility for Secret level clearance Ideally, you'll also have Expertise in developing written and visual communication products Excellent written and oral communication skills Ability to collaborate with clients and identify engagement follow-on opportunities Due to the nature of our work in the Government and Public Sector, work may be required to be completed at client, EY and/or contractor sites. Our goal is to assign professionals to projects within a commutable distance of their work location office. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs. What We Offer You At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $142,600 to $261,500. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $171,200 to $297,200. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year. Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis. For those living in California, please click here for additional information. Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories. EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law. review_candidates.title: Data analysis instructor
review_candidates.description: Company Description DoLab Academy is a training academy focused on helping learners develop practical, job-ready skills in data analysis and related fields. The academy designs structured, hands-on programs that combine theory with real-world projects, equipping participants to succeed in modern, data-driven workplaces. Courses are delivered online, enabling learners to access high-quality instruction from anywhere. DoLab Academy collaborates with experienced professionals to keep its curriculum current, relevant, and aligned with industry needs. Role Description The Data Analysis Instructor will deliver online training sessions and workshops, guiding learners through core data analysis concepts, tools, and best practices. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing lesson plans and learning materials, teaching live virtual classes, recording instructional content, and demonstrating data analysis workflows using common tools and datasets. The instructor will provide feedback on assignments and projects, support learners through Q&A and mentoring, and help assess learner progress against course objectives. The role also involves collaborating with the academy team to improve curriculum content and teaching methods based on learner outcomes and industry trends. This is a remote, contract role. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong data analysis skills, including working with datasets, interpreting results, and communicating insights clearly. Candidates should possess proficiency with common data tools (e.g., spreadsheets, SQL, data visualization platforms, or programming languages used in data analysis). Candidates should possess instructional and facilitation skills, such as lesson planning, explaining complex concepts in accessible terms, and managing live online classes. Candidates should possess communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to provide constructive feedback and support diverse learners in a remote environment. Experience teaching, tutoring, or mentoring in data-related subjects, preferably in an online setting, is beneficial. A background in data analysis, statistics, business intelligence, or a related field (professional experience or relevant degree/certification) is preferred. Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and adapt content based on learner needs and course evaluations is advantageous.

review_candidates.title: Custom Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Project Role : Custom Software Engineer Project Role Description : Lead the effort to design, build and configure applications, acting as the primary point of contact. Must have skills : Microsoft Azure DevOps Good to have skills : NA Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education Summary: As an Azure Platform Engineer, a typical day involves developing, maintaining, and optimizing cloud-based data platform services such as backup & restore, data protection, on-premises to cloud connectivity, and monitoring solutions. The role focuses on ensuring a stable and scalable platform environment for users while automating operational processes to improve usability, efficiency, and system performance. Collaboration with teams and continuous enhancement of platform capabilities are key to delivering reliable cloud infrastructure aligned with business needs. Roles & Responsibilities: Expected to be an SME, collaborate with teams to design and manage Azure platform services. Responsible for key technical decisions related to platform stability and scalability. Engage with multiple teams to support data platform services, cloud integrations, and monitoring solutions. Develop and maintain services such as backup & restore, data protection, and connectivity between on-premises and cloud environments. Drive automation and optimization of operational processes to improve system efficiency and user experience. Contribute to improving platform accessibility for users with limited technical knowledge. Professional & Technical Skills: Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Azure DevOps, Python, Terraform and Azure Networking.. Expertise in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, and YAML. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (ARM, Bicep). Knowledge of data platform architecture and cloud/data engineering concepts. Good to have experience with Azure services including Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks Strong understanding of Agile methodologies. Additional Information: The candidate should have a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience. A 15 years full-time education is required.

review_candidates.title: Senior IT Project Manager (Enterprise Applications)
review_candidates.description: Description Position at Parts Town See What We’re All About As the fastest-growing distributor of restaurant equipment, HVAC and residential appliance parts, we like to do things a little differently. First, you need to understand and demonstrate our Core Values with safety being your first priority. That’s key. But we’re also looking for unique enthusiasm, high integrity, courage to embrace change…and if you know a few jokes, that puts you on the top of our list! Do you have a genius-level knowledge of original equipment manufacturer parts? If not, no problem! We’re more interested in passionate people with fresh ideas from different backgrounds. That’s what keeps us at the top of our game. We’re proud that our workplace has been recognized for its growth and innovation on the Inc. 5000 list 15 years in a row and the Crain’s Fast 50 list ten times. We are honored to be voted by our Chicagoland team as a Chicago Tribune Top Workplace for the last four years. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, go above and beyond and put your ambition to work, all while having some fun, let’s chat – Apply Today! Perks Parts Town Pride – check out our virtual tour and culture! Quarterly profit-sharing bonus Hybrid Work schedule Team member appreciation events and recognition programs Volunteer opportunities Casual dress code On demand pay options: Access your pay as you earn it, to cover unexpected or even everyday expenses All the traditional benefits like health insurance, 401k/401k match, employee assistance programs and time away – don’t worry, we’ve got you covered. The Job at a Glance The Senior IT Project Manager (Enterprise Applications) is responsible for leading the delivery, optimization, and support of enterprise business applications and integration platforms that enable critical business processes across the organization. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and delivery partners to ensure successful implementation, enhancement, and operation of ERP, CRM, integration, EDI, and other enterprise platforms. The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, program leadership, stakeholder management, and process improvement experience to drive scalable and reliable enterprise solutions. A Typical Day Delivery Leadership Lead end-to-end delivery of enterprise application initiatives, including ERP, CRM, integration, supply chain, procurement, and customer-facing platforms. Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and resource allocation. Establish delivery governance, project standards, and release management processes. Coordinate cross-functional teams including business analysts, developers, architects, and external partners. Enterprise Applications Management Own application lifecycle management for critical enterprise systems. Drive system enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure application performance, availability, security, and compliance requirements are met. Develop and maintain application roadmaps aligned with business objectives. Integration & Data Enablement Oversee enterprise integration solutions including APIs, EDI, middleware, and cloud integration platforms. Collaborate with architects to define scalable integration strategies and standards. Ensure reliable data exchange between internal and external systems. Support modernization initiatives leveraging SAP Integration Suite, APIs, cloud services, and automation technologies. Stakeholder Engagement Partner with business leaders to understand strategic priorities and translate them into technology solutions. Facilitate prioritization of application enhancements and project portfolios. Communicate project status, risks, and outcomes to executive leadership. Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and service-level agreements. Operational Excellence Establish KPIs and service metrics for enterprise application delivery and support. Drive process standardization, automation, and operational efficiency initiatives. Ensure adherence to IT governance, security, and compliance frameworks. Lead incident management and problem resolution for critical business applications. Team Leadership Mentor and develop application delivery, business analysis, and support teams. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support resource planning and capability development initiatives. To Land This Opportunity You have 8+ years of experience supporting and delivering enterprise applications. You have 5+ years of experience leading cross-functional projects or application delivery teams. You can speak about your experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar. You demonstrate a strong understanding of enterprise integration technologies, APIs, EDI, and middleware platforms. You exhibit experience managing vendors, system integrators, and third-party technology partners. You have excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. You possess a bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field. About Your Future Team We are about working hard and playing hard. We are about having each others back, taking on responsibility and making things better for all. We are gritty, roll back your sleeves and get the job done with an inclusive, positive can-do attitude. We enjoy our social events, celebrating with food (of course) and celebrating our team members’ life’s milestones and events. At Parts Town, we value transparency and are committed to ensuring our team members feel appreciated and supported. We prioritize our positive workplace culture where collaboration, growth, and work-life balance are celebrated. The salary range for this role is $120,748.62 to $162,954.74 annually which is based on including but not limited to qualifications, experience, and geographical location. Parts Town is a pay for performance-company. In addition to base pay, some roles offer a profit-sharing program, and an annual bonus depending on the role. Our comprehensive benefits package includes health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) with match, employee assistance programs, paid time off, paid sick time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, and professional development opportunities. Parts Town welcomes diversity and as an equal opportunity employer all qualified applicants will be considered regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

review_candidates.title: Mobile Software Engineer, Growth & Experimentation
review_candidates.description: Everis has a different standard for talent. We do not use years of experience, titles, or pedigree as substitutes for ability. We look for exceptional work, sound judgment, fast learning, ownership, and evidence of impact. It is not a lower bar. It is a sharper one. We’re looking for an accomplished software engineer who has built real mobile applications and already has practical exposure to growth, experimentation, conversion optimization, or broader product work. This role requires both engineering depth and evidence that you can think beyond implementation.  Join Everis at a defining stage of growth. Help shape the product, influence the company we become, and grow with us. Work 100% remotely from anywhere, benefit from unlimited leave, and connect with colleagues at company-sponsored international retreats in some of the world’s most inspiring cities. About Everis Everis is a growing, remote-first software company founded by proven technology entrepreneurs Rob Rawson and Liam Martin, who previously built Time Doctor into an eight-figure global SaaS business. We acquire promising mobile apps and SaaS companies, invest in their future, and improve their products, technology, and customer experience. Our ambition is to make Everis the best long-term home for exceptional software products—and a company where exceptional people can take real ownership, do consequential work, and grow with us. About the Product Pebble is Everis’s growing, speaking-first language-learning app for iOS and Android. It helps people learn English, Spanish, and French through practical lessons, pronunciation practice, and guided conversations that get them speaking from day one. The product is live and evolving quickly, with major opportunities across onboarding, habit formation, activation, retention, conversion, and new markets. Your engineering and product decisions will directly influence how well people learn and how quickly Pebble grows. What makes this role different Most engineering roles begin after the problem, solution, and ticket have already been defined. Here, you join the work earlier. You will remain a software engineer first, but you will also identify product problems, decide what to test, build the solution, measure the outcome, and use the evidence to determine what happens next. This is not a marketing role for someone who codes; it is an engineering role with responsibility for product outcomes. What you’ll work on Build, ship, and improve Pebble’s mobile applications. Find friction across onboarding, activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and monetization. Turn product questions into improvements, prototypes, A/B tests, and other useful experiments. Use product and user data to understand behavior and decide what should be built next. Define success measures, analyze results, and act on what you learn. Work directly with our founders and product and business leadership. Balance strong engineering with the speed required to test ideas and learn. What you need to bring This is a mobile engineering job first. You need to have built, shipped, and supported a production mobile app. We mean a real product used by real people - not just a demo or code sample. We also need proof you've thought beyond implementation. Show us at least one of these: Breadth beyond implementation. Direct mobile-growth or conversion work You must show meaningful evidence of at least one of the following: growth experimentation, A/B or split testing, conversion optimization, product ownership, building and operating your own software product. Conversion optimization. You improved a real flow: onboarding, activation, a paywall, trial-to-paid, checkout, or another point where users dropped. Core Stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and sound judgment about reliability, maintainability, quality, and speed. Flutter/Dart, TypeScript/NestJS, MongoDB, or close equivalents; and App Store or Google Play subscriptions, paywalls, payments, or trial-to-paid journeys. Production mobile engineering. Demonstrated success building and shipping production mobile applications using iOS, Android, cross-platform, or another credible mobile environment. Product development or ownership. You helped decide what to build and why. You didn't just receive a finished specification. You can independently take production software from problem through implementation, release, and iteration. Product-management-type work. You framed the problem, made trade-offs, defined success, or used evidence to choose the next move. A product of your own. You built it, launched it, watched real people use it, and changed it based on what you learned. What good looks like Your fundamentals are solid. APIs, data modelling, testing, debugging, release practices, and production monitoring aren't someone else's job. You can tell the whole story. What was wrong, what you personally built, what happened, and what you did next. You cross boundaries when the problem demands it. Mobile, backend, web, data, analytics - you don't stop at the edge of your code. You'd rather find out than argue from theory. You form a view, test it, and change your mind when the evidence says you should. What we offer Compensation: $80,000–$120,000 USD annually, depending on experience. Consequential ownership: your decisions will directly affect Pebble and Everis. Direct founder access: work closely with experienced entrepreneurs on important product and company decisions. Exceptional colleagues: work with capable, curious, high-ownership people held to the same demanding standard. Room to grow: take on larger problems and greater responsibility as Everis expands. 100% remote: work from anywhere. Unlimited leave: take meaningful time away when you need it. Paid international company trips: come together with the team in some of the world’s most inspiring cities—to collaborate, build lasting relationships, and experience somewhere new. Our Recruiting Process We keep our process structured and transparent: Initial review: Application → Written Assessment Skills and reasoning: Recorded Scenario Assessment → Reasoning Intelligence Test → Recorded Role-Specific Assessment Interviews: Technical Interview → Final Interview with a Co-Founder Final evaluation: Paid Work Trial If you are an exceptional mobile engineer who wants to help decide what gets built, prove whether it works, and shape a growing product, we want to hear from you.
